stem: Which sentence best explains why Baatar is surprised when he discovers the sponge?

options.label: A
options.text: "But first, I must demand that you travel west, to a very distant land and find a treasure." (paragraph 4)

options.label: B
options.text: "Is it not something I can get here in Mongolia?" (paragraph 5)

options.label: C
options.text: Of those he met, nobody knew what a sponge was, and nobody knew who his father was, either. (paragraph 12)

options.label: D
options.text: From out of the water, he lifted the dripping thing that he used every day to clean the floor. (paragraph 16)
